related.title: IPv4：分片偏移與重組缺口
related.titleEn: IPv4: fragment offsets and reassembly gaps
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：由另一學徒只使用交付檔案重建兩情境與判定；需同時保留未通過情境。 教學獨立模型漏接門檻0.005；p=0.1通過、0.3失敗；任何實際保護決策另需期限、網路與裝置驗證。 goose_repetition.csv、八結果表與相關失效反例 保留輸入、逐項中間值、名義 0.001 與變更 0.027 all-missed probability、反例、驗收判定與模型限制，供另一學徒從零重算。 附離線證據實驗：python3 tools/curriculum-v28/labs-optical.py --lab comm-v28-210 --out ./comm-v28-210-evidence；輸出目錄必須尚不存在。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: A second apprentice must reconstruct both scenarios and decisions using only the handover files; retain failing cases as well. Teaching independent-model miss limit0.005:p=0.1 passes and0.3 fails; actual protection decisions require deadline, network and device validation. goose_repetition.csv, eight-outcome table and correlated-failure counterexample Preserve inputs, intermediate values, nominal 0.001 and changed 0.027 all-missed probability, counterexamples, acceptance decisions and model limits so another apprentice can reproduce them. Offline evidence lab: python3 tools/curriculum-v28/labs-optical.py --lab comm-v28-210 --out ./comm-v28-210-evidence; the output directory must not already exist.
related.difference: 建立 offset、length、MF 表，畫出每片涵蓋的半開位元組區間。
related.differenceEn: Construct offset, length and MF columns and draw the half-open byte interval covered by each fragment.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 合成觀察窗內三次傳送、各次丟失0.1；擾動0.3，暫假設獨立，並另設共同斷線對照情境。 名義式 0.1**3 = 0.001 all-missed probability；變更式 0.3**3 = 0.027 all-missed probability。逐項標示量綱，先代入未四捨五入數值再作比較。 手算名義式並保存所有中間項，實作下列獨立驗證而非只抄最終數字： 列三位元接收/遺失八種結果，總機率1；加入共同斷線機率c時需改為c+(1−c)p³，不能仍用p³。

分片偏移以八位元組為單位；除最後片段外，資料長度須對齊八位元組。
教學基準：ceil(3980/1480) = 3 fragments；對照：ceil(3980/600) = 7 fragments。所有數值、事件、期限與門檻是本課明示的合成教學情境，並非官方設備規格、營運網路量測或部署建議。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Synthetic three transmissions within an observation window with loss0.1 each, changed to0.3; assume independence and include a separate common-outage comparison. Nominal 0.1**3 = 0.001 all-missed probability; changed 0.3**3 = 0.027 all-missed probability. Label dimensions, substitute unrounded values and only then compare. Calculate the nominal expression with intermediate terms and implement this independent validation rather than copying the final number: Enumerate eight three-bit receipt/loss outcomes summing to one; common-outage probabilityc changes the result toc+(1−c)p cubed.

Fragment offsets use eight-octet units; all but the last fragment need eight-octet payload alignment.
Teaching baseline: ceil(3980/1480) = 3 fragments; comparison: ceil(3980/600) = 7 fragments. All numeric inputs, events, timers and limits are explicit synthetic teaching conditions, not official equipment specifications, operational-network measurements or deployment recommendations.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.difference: 分開租約起點、T1、T2、到期四欄，並記錄伺服器是否有覆寫選項。
related.differenceEn: Record lease start, T1, T2 and expiry separately and flag server-provided overrides.

教學基準：3600*0.875-3600*0.5 = 1350 s；對照：7200*0.875-7200*0.5 = 2700 s。所有數值、事件、期限與門檻是本課明示的合成教學情境，並非官方設備規格、營運網路量測或部署建議。

Calculate the nominal expression with intermediate terms and implement this independent validation rather than copying the final number: Enumerate eight three-bit receipt/loss outcomes summing to one; common-outage probabilityc changes the result toc+(1−c)p cubed.

DHCP leases have renewal and rebinding phases; servers can supply T1/T2, so default ratios are not universal.
